assessment: Reviewed all 35 Knowledge Units, their Evidence references, 15 relationships and 8 explicit uncertainties. Propositions remain bounded: real-field data versus deployed algorithms, synthetic and controlled anomalies versus genuine production incidents, retrospective ECG and sepsis challenges versus clinical deployment, event-only wind gearbox database versus wind-SCADA monitoring, retrospective semiconductor shipment features versus operating sensor streams, AML transaction aggregates versus confirmed temporal-dependency models and ShakeAlert earthquake detection versus pre-event earthquake prediction. Distinct tasks—current anomaly/event detection, change-point detection, fault diagnosis, future event warning, and RUL/cycle life—are not conflated; reported lead-time requirements and empirical achievements are kept separate. These qualifications support the cross-source descriptive taxonomy without implying sector prevalence or causal benefits.
